title: Evaluating GPT-4 and ChatGPT on Japanese Medical Licensing Examinations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance, tokenization costs, and context window limits on the Japanese medical licensing examination to highlight performance disparities and inefficiencies for languages typologically distant from English.

Analyzing model responses to Japan-specific medical scenarios to identify English-centric assumptions, specifically evaluating how often models select "prohibited choices" (e.g., recommending euthanasia, which is illegal in Japan) or fail on geographic-specific public health questions.
